verdict: Leads dropped 35% this week; Google spend is not converting and is under review.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 133 leads entirely through Meta at a blended cost per lead of $16.49 — Google Ads generated zero leads from $501 spent and 109 clicks, a confirmed tracking issue that is being resolved now. The sharpest pressure came in the most recent 7 days, where leads fell 35% and cost per lead rose 30% week-over-week, driven by reduced Google spend and a near-complete drop in Google Business Profile activity. The early days of this week (Sep 14–16) show a partial recovery on Meta — 16 leads across three days — though spend also recovered in parallel, so no efficiency gain yet. Google conversion tracking is being repaired so those clicks can be properly attributed; until that fix is confirmed live, Google spend remains paused or limited. The pipeline setup work — including paid landing pages and the full CRM build — is also being completed this month, which is needed before either channel can scale efficiently.
